meta.notes: All timestamps are local to timeZone; stage/stream/workout times use MM-dd HH:mm:ss format anchored at 2025-12-31 (Europe/Belgrade). Consecutive same-stage sleep intervals are merged. Vitals are summarized per session with min/avg/max/p50/p90 and per-stage averages; oxygenSaturation is percent. Streams are tuples ordered by tupleSchema with hoisted unit/source; dense streams carry downsampledTo and are avg/min/max bins (verbose exports keep full resolution). Activity daily summaries use local-time day buckets with source-deduplicated sums (matches the Health app; overlapping iPhone/Watch samples are not double-counted); distance is in kilometres. additional.* sections report one row per day; their aggregation map says whether each metric is a daily sum, average of readings, or the day's latest reading. Sleep sessions overlapping the range are included in full, so stages/streams may extend outside the range. Daily rows with no recorded data are omitted, and a range ending mid-day means the last day is partial.
